# Clinical Assessment

Clinical assessment refers to the diagnostic evaluation process used in the [[adhd|ADHD]] care pathway, encompassing both physical (somatic) examination and structured questionnaire-based measures. Two distinct facets of this process are documented in the corpus: a Danish steering-group recommendation on somatic workup, and a clinical tool for quantifying symptom severity and functional impact.

In [[danmark|Denmark]], a steering group ("Styregruppen") has assessed that somatic examination is an important part of clinical assessment, both to rule out possible somatic differential diagnoses and to identify any co-occurring somatic conditions a patient may have alongside their presenting symptoms [^src1]. This underscores that clinical assessment in the Danish context is not purely psychiatric or behavioral — physical health is treated as an integral part of ruling out alternative explanations and catching comorbid conditions.

On the ADHD side specifically, clinical assessment is described as building on a clinical history (anamnesis) that is supplemented with standardized questionnaire data measuring symptom severity, using the ADHD-RS instrument. This is ideally complemented by additional questionnaires assessing functional impairment resulting from ADHD symptoms, such as WFIRS, CGI, GAPD or GAF, and ABAS [^src2]. Together, these two claims show clinical assessment as a multi-layered process: somatic screening to exclude or identify other physical conditions, paired with structured, validated questionnaire tools to measure both the severity of ADHD symptoms and their real-world functional impact.

## Claims

**ADHD_2023.pdf, page 11** (Source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2023.pdf, pages 11-15)
- Styregruppen vurderer, at somatisk undersøgelse er vigtig både ift. mulige somatiske differentialdiagnoser og evt. andre samtidige somatiske tilstande (danmark) [^src1]
  - Type: clinical-assessment

**ADHD_2024.pdf, page 56** (Source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2024.pdf, pages 56-60)
- Anamnesen suppleres med spørgeskema-data vedr. symptomernes sværhedsgrad (ADHD-RS), gerne suppleret med spørgeskema om funktionspåvirkningen som følge af ADHD-symptomerne (eks. WFIRS, CGI, GAPD eller GAF, ABAS) [^src1] (adhd) [^src2]
  - Type: clinical-assessment
